name: k6-performance-framework
description: Production-grade k6 TypeScript performance test automation framework for Conduit RealWorld API

scripts.health: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/health-results.json dist/smoke/health-check.js
scripts.smoke: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/smoke-results.json dist/smoke/smoke-test.js
scripts.load: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/load-results.json dist/load/articles-load.js
scripts.load:journey: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/user-journey-results.json dist/load/user-journey-load.js
scripts.stress: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/stress-results.json dist/stress/articles-stress.js
scripts.stress:auth: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/auth-stress-results.json dist/stress/auth-stress.js
scripts.spike: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/spike-results.json dist/spike/traffic-spike.js
scripts.soak: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/soak-results.json dist/soak/endurance-soak.js
scripts.breakpoint: npm run build && k6 run --out json=reports/breakpoint-results.json dist/breakpoint/breakpoint-test.js
scripts.load:observed: npm run build && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile test run --rm k6 run --out xk6-influxdb=http://influxdb:8086 --out opentelemetry dist/load/articles-load.js
